# ByteIt API — Python SDK endpoints (v2.0.0)

<!-- GENERATED by contracts/generators/sdk_package_docs.py; do not edit -->

Every operation of the API in this SDK (22 in total). Base URL `https://byteit.ai`, authentication with your API key (`X-API-Key`). Inputs use the API's field names (`name?` is optional); the Python SDK spells them as in the call. Types and an example for each call: [reference.md](reference.md).

## Parse jobs

Parse documents into text, Markdown, HTML or JSON.

| Operation | Call | Inputs | HTTP |
|---|---|---|---|
| Create parse job | `client.parse_jobs.create(...) -> CreateParseJobResponse` | `file?` `files?` `nickname?` `output_format?` `input_connector?` `input_connection_data?` `output_connector?` `output_connection_data?` `processing_options?` `queue_for_batch?` | `POST /v1/jobs/parse-jobs/` |

## Extract jobs

Extract structured data from a parsed document with a JSON schema.

| Operation | Call | Inputs | HTTP |
|---|---|---|---|
| Create extract job | `client.extract_jobs.create(...) -> CreateExtractJobResponse` | `parse_job_id` `schema` `extraction_complexity?` | `POST /v1/jobs/extract-jobs/` |

## Custom jobs

|---|---|---|---|

## Jobs

Get, list, rename and download the results of any job, and follow its progress.

| Operation | Call | Inputs | HTTP |
|---|---|---|---|
| List jobs | `client.jobs.list(...) -> ReadJobsListResponse` | `before?` `job_type?` `limit?` | `GET /v1/jobs/` |
| Get job | `client.jobs.get(...) -> Job` | `id` | `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/` |
| Update job nickname | `client.jobs.update_nickname(...) -> Job` | `id` `nickname?` | `PATCH /v1/jobs/{id}/` |
| Download job input file | `client.jobs.download_input_file(...) -> typing.Iterator[bytes]` | `id` | `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/input-file/` |
| Download job result | `client.jobs.download_result(...) -> typing.Iterator[bytes]` | `id` `include_extras?` `output_format?` | `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/result/` |
| Get job processing status with progress | `client.jobs.get_status(...) -> ReadJobStatusResponse` | `id` | `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/status/` |
